features.name: Scenario list with SplitView navigation
features.description: The app displays a SplitView pane on the left with a ListBox listing all 7 scenarios. Clicking a scenario navigates the right-side Frame to the corresponding page. A hamburger toggle button opens/closes the pane.
expected_behaviour: A left sidebar pane lists all 7 scenarios by title
Clicking a scenario navigates the content frame to that scenario's page
A hamburger button toggles the sidebar pane open/closed
The header shows 'Universal Windows Platform sample' branding

features.name: Status bar at bottom of content area
features.description: A status bar at the bottom of the content area shows status messages from scenarios (e.g. 'Loaded' or error messages). It includes a 'Status:' label and a scrollable text block.
expected_behaviour: A 'Status:' label is visible at the bottom of the content area
Status messages from scenario operations appear in the status block
The status block is scrollable when content overflows

features.name: Scenario 1: Simplest Adaptive Streaming
features.description: A simple page with a description, a 'Load' button, and a MediaPlayerElement. Clicking Load sets the media source to an adaptive streaming URI.
expected_behaviour: Description text explains implicit AdaptiveMediaSource creation
A 'Load' button is present and clickable
A MediaPlayerElement with transport controls is visible
Clicking Load sets the media source (player shows loading/playing state)

features.name: Scenario 2: Event Handlers
features.description: Demonstrates explicit AdaptiveMediaSource usage with event reporting. Shows download/playback bitrate icons and text, a ContentSelector control, MediaPlayerElement, and a LogView.
expected_behaviour: ContentSelector control allows choosing streaming content
Download and playback bitrate indicators (SymbolIcon bars + text) are visible
MediaPlayerElement with transport controls is present
LogView control shows streaming event log entries

features.name: Scenario 3: Network Request Modification
features.description: Allows the user to select authentication methods (None, Authorization Header, URL Query Parameter, Application Downloaded) via radio buttons. Also includes HDCP protection level selection.
expected_behaviour: Four authentication method radio buttons are present and selectable
Three HDCP protection level radio buttons are present
Effective protection text updates based on selection
ContentSelector, MediaPlayerElement, and LogView are present

features.name: Scenario 4: Adaptive Streaming Tuning
features.description: Provides tuning controls: min/initial/max bitrate ComboBoxes, downgrade ratio and headroom ratio TextBox+Button pairs. Shows bitrate indicators.
expected_behaviour: Three ComboBoxes for min, initial, and max bitrate are present
Downgrade ratio TextBox with Set button is present
Headroom ratio TextBox with Set button is present
Bitrate icons and inbound bitrate display are visible
ContentSelector, MediaPlayerElement, and LogView are present

features.name: Scenario 5: Metadata
features.description: Shows consumption/creation of timed metadata from HLS/DASH streams. Has ContentSelector, MediaPlayerElement, and LogView.
expected_behaviour: Description explains timed metadata from HLS/DASH
ContentSelector, MediaPlayerElement, and LogView are present
Metadata events appear in the log when streaming content is loaded

features.name: Scenario 6: Ad Insertion
features.description: Demonstrates ad insertion with pre-roll, mid-roll, and post-roll ads. Uses MediaPlaybackList with playback progress reporting via timed metadata.
expected_behaviour: Description explains ad insertion with pre-roll, mid-roll, and post-roll
ContentSelector, MediaPlayerElement, and LogView are present
Ad insertion and progress events appear in the log

features.name: Scenario 7: Live Seekable Range
features.description: Shows seekable range controls for live DVR content. Includes MaxSeekableWindowSize, DesiredSeekableWindowSize (with Set button), DesiredLiveOffset (with Set button), MinLiveOffset displays, position tracking, and discrete seek buttons.
expected_behaviour: Seekable window controls grid shows Max/Desired/LiveOffset/Min fields
Position tracking shows Start/Current/End positions with a Slider
Discrete seek buttons (<<15m, <<5m, <<30s, <<2s, Play, Pause, 2s>>, etc.) are present
GoToStart and GoToLive buttons are present
